race.comment: LONGER ROUTE (2) is yet to strike through this prep but came desperately close last start at Mildura. At peak fitness now and gets in well with the 3kg claim. Can go one better. CHANCE TAKEN (15) is ticking along nicely and doesn't need to improve much to land the winning blow but will need a touch of luck from the draw. PETIT EAGLE (6) has struck a purple patch of form as she shoots for the hat-trick. Will be hoping for a strong tempo so she can be launching home once more. MOUSSAKA (5) is also shooting for three on the bounce and with added fitness he's right in the mix. He's another though that is drawn wide, so treading lightly. GEETEE FORTY (16) hasn't won for a long time but there are runs littered through his form that can measure up under the light weight.
